english.title: Sign / authorise signing of document where registered society's registered name does not appear in legible characters

english.legislation: Contrary to section 11(3)(b) of the Co-operative and Community Benefit Societies Act 2014.

english.notes: A person convicted of an offence under section 11(3) of the Co-operative and Community Benefit Societies Act 2014 by virtue of subsection (3)(b) is also personally liable to the holder of the document for the amount specified in the document unless that amount is duly paid by the society.
